role: The 15-rule default trigger catalogue for WorkoutTriggerEngine, as factory functions each pairing a condition predicate and message builder (plus a didFire hook where firing spends state), with small closure-captured state classes for rules that need per-workout memory (α1 VT2 streak, HR-spike streak, strap link, threshold cooldowns, readiness/race-pace/periodic/load once-flags).
types: Alpha1Reading: struct (fileprivate, Equatable) — α1 value + fit R², identifies one recompute
StrapLinkState: class (private) — observedSecond, previous, current strap link
state: closure-captured per-rule instances of Alpha1VT2State, HRSpikeState, StrapLinkState, ThresholdCooldownState, ReadinessOpeningState, RacePaceState, CoachUpdateState, RecentLoadState (one per engine, created when defaultRules(settings:) runs)
static let racePaceMaxCreditSec = 5 (longest tick gap credited as time at race pace)
toplevel: Header comment: conditions may only track per-reading streak state keyed on the reading (idempotent per snapshot); state spent by firing goes in didFire.

flags.text: Only user.threshold.breach is .spoken. The other 14 rules are .silent (11) or .haptic (3: hr.spikeNoPace, equipment.strapDown, cadence.consistencyDrop) and WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch drops both tiers, so their messages, including the long 'Speak ONE short sentence…' LLM prompts for decoupling, readiness, race pace, periodic and load rules, are never spoken or sent to any model. The prompt text implies an AI path that does not exist. Deleting the silent rules, surfacing their history, or sending the prompts to a model is a product decision (see WorkoutTriggerEngine.swift's history flag).

units.does: Returns the four effort rules in order: alpha1.belowAeT, alpha1.aboveVT2, hr.driftHigh, hr.spikeNoPace.
Returns true when α1 fit R² is unknown or ≥ 0.85; false when the last DFA fit is poor.

branches.effect: nil: returns true (gate passes when quality unknown); else returns r2 >= 0.85

units.does: Builds rule alpha1.belowAeT: tier .silent: event only lands in the engine's unread in-memory history (WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch ignores .silent), routine, 20 min cooldown, condition alpha1BelowAeTCondition, message alpha1BelowAeTMessage.
True when the fit-quality gate passes and α1 is in [0.60, 0.75).

Localized line quoting α1 to 2 dp and calling it the aerobic edge, offering to back off or hold for tempo; numbers are formatted with String(format:locale: .current), so the decimal separator follows the user's locale.

branches.effect: would print 0.75; unreachable because the condition requires α1 non-nil on the same ctx

units.does: Builds rule alpha1.aboveVT2 (.silent, routine, 15 min cooldown) with a fresh Alpha1VT2State captured by its condition, message and reset closures.

Requires the fit gate and a known α1, else resets the streak (a rejected window breaks it) and returns false. On each NEW reading (α1 and fit R² together differ from the last one counted) increments consecutiveBelow when α1 < 0.50 else resets it; fires when the streak is ≥ 2 and current α1 < 0.50. The same snapshot evaluated twice counts once. Reads no target zone or intent.

branches.effect: true: records it and updates streak; false: streak unchanged (same recompute seen again)

units.does: Localized line quoting α1 and saying the user is above anaerobic threshold, easing up optional; numbers are formatted with String(format:locale: .current), so the decimal separator follows the user's locale.

branches.effect: prints 0.00; unreachable since the condition requires α1

units.does: Resets the α1 VT2 streak to 0 and clears lastReading.
Builds rule hr.driftHigh (.silent, routine, 20 min cooldown) with hrDriftHighCondition / hrDriftHighMessage.
Fires when live HR drift > 5% after 30 min, grade is known and within ±2%, and recent HR slope is known and non-negative.

branches.effect: true: false (HR falling); else returns true

units.does: Localized drift line with drift %, plus current HR and signed grade when known (four phrasing variants); numbers are formatted with String(format:locale: .current), so the decimal separator follows the user's locale.

branches.effect: prints 0; unreachable because condition requires drift
HR + grade + drift sentence (the only reachable case when HR is known, since condition requires grade)
HR + drift; unreachable: condition requires grade
grade + drift; used when no HR sample yet
drift only; unreachable: condition requires grade

units.does: Builds rule hr.spikeNoPace (.haptic → no-op in coach, routine, 10 min cooldown) with a fresh HRSpikeState.

Counts one sample per workout second: on a new elapsedSeconds it records the second and increments consecutiveAbove when hrSpikeSampleQualifies, else resets it to 0 (any failing gate breaks the run). Fires at streak ≥ 2; a spike held at a constant HR counts every second, and the same snapshot evaluated twice counts once.

branches.effect: true: update streak; false: streak unchanged

units.does: One sample's test: true when HR and a positive max HR are known, the sport uses GPS, current pace, a positive most-recent split pace and a grade within ±2% are known, HR > 85% of max and current pace is more than 5% slower than the last split.

branches.cond: HR, max HR > 0, GPS sport, pace, last split > 0, grade within ±2% all hold
HR > 85% max AND pace > last split × 1.05

units.does: Localized 'pace didn't pick up' line with HR and signed grade when known (four variants); numbers are formatted with String(format:locale: .current), so the decimal separator follows the user's locale.

branches.effect: HR + grade sentence — the only reachable case (condition requires HR and grade)

units.does: Resets the HR-spike streak to 0 and lastSampleSecond to -1.
Returns zone.drifted.high, zone.drifted.low, route.climbAhead in order (route.climbAhead is the one climb rule).
Builds rule zone.drifted.high (.silent, 150 s cooldown) with zoneDriftedHighCondition / zoneDriftedHighMessage.
Fires when a target zone and HR are known, HR fraction of max exceeds the target zone's top (N×0.10+0.50) by > 3 points after 60 s, and grade is known and ≤ +2%.

branches.effect: false: false; for target zone 5 the bound is 1.03 × max HR so it practically never fires
true: false (climbing); else true (descents not suppressed)

units.does: Localized 'drifted above Zone N' line with HR.

branches.effect: Zone 0; unreachable since condition requires target

units.does: Builds rule zone.drifted.low (.silent, 150 s cooldown): fires when target zone > 1, HR fraction is > 3 points below the bottom of the target zone, after 180 s; message says HR is easier than Zone N.

branches.cond: targetZone known and > 1, heartRate known, userMaxHR > 0
branches.effect: false: returns false (zone 1 target never fires low); true: compares pct to lowerBound - 0.03 and elapsed > 180

units.does: Builds rule route.climbAhead (.silent, 8 min cooldown) with routeClimbAheadCondition / routeClimbAheadMessage.
True when an upcoming climb starts between 0 and 500 m ahead (exclusive).
Builds the route-climb sentence: distance in yards (imperial) or metres, grade percent, optional climb length, and 'First of N' when routeTopology lists more than one climb ahead.
Chooses one of four localized sentences by whether a length label exists and whether more than one climb is ahead.

Spoken climb length: nil when length ≤ 0; imperial gives feet under 0.1 mi else miles (1 dp); metric gives metres under 0.1 km else km (1 dp); numbers are formatted with String(format:locale: .current), so the decimal separator follows the user's locale.
Returns equipment.strapDown, user.threshold.breach, cadence.consistencyDrop in order.

Builds rule equipment.strapDown (.haptic, urgent, 60 s cooldown) with a fresh StrapLinkState: fires on the workout second the strap goes from connected to not connected (strapDroppedCondition), so a strapless workout never fires; message says the strap went quiet and HR switches to the Watch; reset clears the link state.
Sets observedSecond to -1 and previous/current strap link to false.
On a new workout second shifts the strap link (previous = current, current = ctx.strapConnected); returns true when the strap was connected on the previous second and is not now.

branches.effect: true: shift the link history; false: unchanged (same snapshot)

units.does: Builds the only .spoken rule, user.threshold.breach (urgent, 30 s floor cooldown), with a ThresholdCooldownState: condition is 'any due threshold', message picks the longest-breached one, didFire starts that threshold's own cooldown (only when the rule fires, which the engine allows only when it can be heard), reset clears lastSpokenAt.
Filters active thresholds to those breached > 0 s and ≥ their debounce whose own cooldown (on the workout clock) has expired since last spoken, sorted by longest breach first.

branches.effect: none: due; else due only if elapsed - last >= cooldownSec

units.does: Takes the first due threshold and returns its user cue if non-empty or the threshold's default cue using the observed metric value; if none due returns 'Threshold breached.' Changes no state.

branches.effect: none: returns generic 'Threshold breached.' (only if state changed between condition and message, which does not happen in evaluate)
returns user cue verbatim; else defaultCue(currentValue:)

units.does: didFire hook of user.threshold.breach: looks up the same first due threshold the message picked and stamps its lastSpokenAt with the current workout second.
Returns the live reading for the threshold's metric (HR, power, pace, α1, cadence, 0 when unsampled) or the threshold's own value for other metrics.

branches.cond: default (zone, %FTP, distance, elapsed, elevation, grade, naturalLanguage)

units.does: Builds rule cadence.consistencyDrop (.haptic → no-op, 8 min cooldown): fires when cadence drift < -5 spm after 15 min; message reports the drop; numbers are formatted with String(format:locale: .current), so the decimal separator follows the user's locale.

Returns aerobic.decouplingMaterial, readiness.openingRecommendation, race.paceMode.detected, coach.periodicUpdate (built over the given settings provider), training.recentLoadAboveUsualRange in order.

Builds rule aerobic.decouplingMaterial (.silent, 15 min cooldown): fires when decoupling > 5% after 25 min unless grade is known and > +2%; message is an English LLM prompt; numbers are formatted with String(format:locale: .current), so the decimal separator follows the user's locale.

branches.effect: true: false; nil grade passes (fail-open, unlike hr.driftHigh and zone.drifted.high)

units.does: Builds rule readiness.openingRecommendation (.silent, cooldown 0) with a ReadinessOpeningState; message is an English LLM prompt for a push/back-off framing; didFire sets fired (once per workout); reset clears fired.
True between 180 s and 600 s when not yet fired this workout and any of recovery score, TSB or days-until-fresh is known. Changes no state (the rule's didFire sets fired).

branches.effect: false: false (window missed means never fires)

units.does: Builds rule race.paceMode.detected (.silent, cooldown 0) with a RacePaceState; message is an English LLM prompt about holding 5K race pace; didFire sets fired (once per workout); reset clears the state.

Until the rule has fired this workout, after 5 min, with current pace and a positive 5K prediction known, accumulates workout-clock seconds (elapsedSeconds deltas, each capped at racePaceMaxCreditSec = 5) while pace stays within ±3% of predicted 5K pace, restarting the window when it leaves the band; true once 120 contiguous seconds are reached. A pause or the same snapshot evaluated twice adds nothing.

branches.cond: not fired, elapsed >= 300, pace > 0 known, 5K prediction > 0 known

branches.effect: true: adds min(max(0, elapsed - last), 5) seconds; false: no accumulation this tick

units.does: Zeros sustainedSec, sets lastElapsedSec to the given workout second, returns false.
Zeros sustainedSec, clears fired and lastElapsedSec.

Builds rule coach.periodicUpdate (.silent, cooldown 0) with a CoachUpdateState; its condition reads settings through the given provider each tick; didFire stamps the workout second it fired; reset clears it.

With the injected settings: when periodic updates are enabled, elapsed ≥ cadence (min 60 s), at least one cadence of workout time has passed since the last fire, and a live trend signal exists, returns true. Changes no state (the rule's didFire stamps the fire).

branches.cond: lastFiredElapsedSec set and elapsed - last < cadence

units.does: True when any of live HR drift, decoupling, reverse-split delta or cadence drift is present; a cross-workout baseline alone does not count.
English LLM prompt stating minutes elapsed and asking for one sentence about the single most relevant signal, or silence.
Builds rule training.recentLoadAboveUsualRange (.silent, cooldown 0) with a RecentLoadState; didFire sets fired (once per workout); reset clears fired.
True when not yet fired this workout and today's ATL/CTL ratio is ≥ 1.4 (CTL > 0). No elapsed-time gate, so it fires on the first tick. Changes no state (the rule's didFire sets fired).

branches.cond: todayATL and todayCTL known with CTL > 0

units.does: English LLM prompt describing recent load as above (≥1.4) or noticeably above (≥1.5) the usual range without naming ACWR.
